verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform and its published agent skills, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry setting, an analytics opt-out, or a usage-tracking control in Sprinto or its compliance-skills repo.
